TANNGUYEN-OH - dua len Cloudflare Pages
1. Vao dash.cloudflare.com > Workers & Pages > Create > Pages > Upload assets.
2. Dat ten du an, keo tha file ZIP nay (hoac giai nen roi keo tha ca 3 file index.html, three.min.js, peerjs.min.js).
3. Bam Deploy. Mo link *.pages.dev la choi duoc.
Choi online 2 nguoi: mot nguoi bam "Tao phong" va gui ma 5 ky tu (hoac link) cho ban be. Ban be mo cung trang, nhap ma la vao.
Can mo bang HTTPS (Cloudflare Pages co san) va ca hai may deu co Internet.

TRANG TIN TUC CONG NGHE & AI (tin-tuc.html)
- Mo https://<ten-du-an>.pages.dev/tin-tuc.html. Trang tu lay tin RSS tu cac bao (VnExpress, Tuoi Tre, Thanh Nien,
  Dan Tri, VietNamNet, Znews, VTC News, NLD, Lao Dong, Nhan Dan, VnEconomy, CafeBiz, GenK, 24h, Tinh te),
  tu lam moi moi 5 phut. Nho upload ca thu muc "assets" (logo).
- On dinh nhat: tao Cloudflare Worker tu file cloudflare-worker/rss-proxy.js trong repo, roi dan URL worker vao
  bien CUSTOM_PROXY o dau phan <script> cua tin-tuc.html. Neu khong, trang dung proxy CORS cong khai (co the cham/gioi han).
- Neu deploy bang Git hoac "npx wrangler pages deploy dist" (chay o thu muc goc repo), file functions/api/rss.js
  tu hoat dong tai /api/rss, khong can Worker rieng.
